CompanyDescription.label: Company Description
CompanyDescription.value: Bank OZK (Nasdaq: OZK), through its Real Estate Specialties Group (RESG), provides financing on commercial real estate projects throughout the nation. RESG is considered a preeminent, market-leading construction lender focused on senior secured financing for a variety of property types including mixed use, multifamily housing, condominiums, office, hospitality, life sciences, industrial, cold storage, self-storage and retail. For the five years ended June 30, 2026, RESG originated approximately $38.75 billion in new loans.
